:::{#exr-dot-linear-practice}
#### Finding a dot product from two known dot products

@thm-dot-linear lets a [dot product](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-dot-product) with a combination
be found from the dot products with its parts.
Suppose that $\vecf{x} \cdot \vecf{u} = 3$
and $\vecf{x} \cdot \vecf{w} = -1$.

Find $\vecf{x} \cdot (2\,\vecf{u} + 5\,\vecf{w})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-dot-linear with $a = 2$ and $b = 5$.

:::

:::
